rationale: Mocked deterministic setup, connection and download contracts protect the core package; real Python, authentication and network integration remain optional.
Supported current packed-data, missingness, offset, UTC, irregular-time and duplicate contracts are tested; remaining CF/time branches belong to the CF/interoperability stage.
A4-EXIT certifies schema V1 globally with zero active legacy runtime producers.
A4R controls S2 locally, restores caller state and records a truthful scientific method.
Filled polygon distance semantics are explicit, scientifically stable and regression tested; boundary-only semantics require a separate API review.
A5b implements the exact local read-only deferred cube_open contract while read_nc remains eager.
Redistribution remains UNKNOWN and no rights are claimed; three governed NOAA/NCEI fixtures provide offline cross-contract evidence.
Map, section, profile, transect and timeseries scientific payload parity is executable.
Valid and invalid memory/NetCDF contract outcomes remain equivalent.
Deterministic generators, singleton axes, structured missingness, non-mutation and preservation invariants pass.
Calibrated OS peak RSS, required tiers and connection/file-lifecycle stress evidence have no RED result.
OISST, ETOPO and WOA governed fixtures have checksums, derivation, attribution and offline CI evidence.
Sparse slice/extract read a minimum enclosing physical envelope; behavior is documented, bounded below collect, guarded by parity and has no RED classification.
Explicit depth_name=zlev is safe today; metadata-aware axis discovery is CF/interoperability work.
ETOPO truthfully lacks time and remains rejected; a static-field contract must precede runtime support.
Native months-since climatological time remains deliberately rejected pending calendar and CF architecture.
